propositions: Add an advisory plan-review criterion no-file-impact that judges whether a ticket asserting no repository-file impact actually describes work requiring a file change.
The criterion is deterministically routed to run only when persisted file_impact_scope is exactly none; paths, undeclared, missing, None, and unknown values must not incur an LLM call or finding.
The declared no_file_impact_reason must round-trip into the Pass-1 request via deterministic JSON structured context, with a missing reason serialized as an explicit empty string.

Required source, config, test, or documentation changes produce advisory contradiction findings, external-only deliverables PASS, and vague/ungrounded plans produce non-blocking insufficient coaching, none of which blocks claim.
The criterion is registered in the canonical registry, exposed via rebar explain, and its generated criteria guide must regenerate byte-identically.
A defect-seeded mutation reintroducing always-selected routing must fail a held-out applicability test that passes when the implementation is restored.
